description: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission product recalls from SaferProducts.gov. Searches recall titles only (not all text). Returns recall number, date, hazard, remedy and the official CPSC page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

limit.description: How many recalls to return, 1 to 20 (default 5)

q.description: Words that must appear in the recall title, 2 to 100 characters
